Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Twi'lek''' was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Despayre]]. When [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Rianna Saren]] ended up in captivity on Despayre and orchestrated her escape, the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] showed Saren an air duct leading to the surface of the planet.<ref name="Lethal Alliance" />
